how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_002.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.transce: Allows the items to gain more engravings with EP.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.tsukumo: Makes only the owner of the weapon be able to use its full potential.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.vigor.d: Increases the amount of Energy the weapon and its wielder gain.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.vitalit: Constantly raises the vitality from the wielder and surrounding while providing high magical resistance and defense.
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.colossusRespawn.de: Respawns the Elemental Colossus when a player who hasn't won against a colossus before reaches the arena in the Labyrinth
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.demonLordAwaken.de: The number of Soul Points needed to be a True Demon Lord
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.demonLordSeed.desc: The amount of EP needed to be a Demon Lord Seed
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.disableDaemonAutoM: Disables daemons players from auto learn Aspectual Magics
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.disableSpiritualLi: Disables the ep limit that applies on spiritual players when entering a physical world
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.epDeathPenalty.des: The percentage of EP that the player will lose when respawning
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.epGainMultiplier.d: The multiplier of EP gain that an entity and its gear would get after defeating a target
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.epSteal.descriptio: Enables certain skills to steal Energy (EP/MP/AP) from Players
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.forceHarvestFestiv: The number of Souls needed to force the player into Harvest Festival for True Demon Lord
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.hardcoreRace.descr: Makes some Races harder to play as
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.labyrinthDeath.des: Allows players to die in the Labyrinth Dimension instead of getting teleported out at 1HP
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.labyrinthPvp.descr: Allows players to pvp in the Labyrinth Dimension
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.maxApGain.descript: Maximum amount of Aura an entity can gain at once from killing a target
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.maxMpGain.descript: Maximum amount of Magicule an entity can gain at once from killing a target
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.maximumMagicExplos: The maximum radius in block that a Magic Explosion can grief the surrounding
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.moddedEP.descripti: How much percentage of default EP value that non-tensura modded mobs can be used for EP gain calculation
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.mpSkillCost.descri: The percentage of MP that the player will lose when gaining a new skill
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.noUniqueStart.desc: Starts with a buff in MP/AP but no Unique Skills
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.npcGrief.descripti: Allows Tensura humanoid NPCs to interact with the environment regardless of the Mob Griefing gamerule
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.npcWorking.descrip: Allows Tensura humanoid NPCs to do their profession/job like farming, chopping trees, fishing, etc.
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.playerEP.descripti: How much percentage of default EP value that fallen players can be used for EP gain calculation
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.playerManualDodgin: Whether if players are allowed to use the keybind-based dodging feature
Enables certain skills to mind control Players
items.lang|tensura|gamerule.playerNaming.descr: Allows players to be named by others
